author: GameTrailers
description: Hard Edge: War Zone, set in the universe of the retro-futuristic world of Hard Edge, is out now on Steam. Watch the Hard Edge: War Zone launch trailer for this tactical card game. Hard Edge: War Zone is a spin-off title of Hard Edge, a game originally released for the PlayStation in 1998.
title: Hard Edge: War Zone - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Pathogenic is available now on Steam. Watch the Pathogenic launch trailer to see gameplay and more from this cellular roguelike shooter game. You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.
title: Pathogenic - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Dance to the rhythm of your own melody and let the crowd follow. Check out Luna Snow's Carmine Cassette costume in this latest Marvel Rivals trailer for the third-person team-shooter action game. Luna Snow's Carmine Cassette costume will be available in Marvel Rivals Season 9 from today, July 24 at 12:10 PM PT to August 21 at 2 AM UTC.

#IGN #SDCC
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Luna Snow: Carmine Cassette Costume Trailer | Comic Con 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Marvel Rivals Path to Doomsday - Avengers: Age of Ultron Mode teaser trailer for this upcoming PvE game mode coming to the third-person team-shooter action game. The Age of Ultron mode integrates the new storyline inspired by the movie into the game. Players will use Avengers Super Heroes to battle against Ultron's army, fighting through Avengers Tower and Ultron's Data Space. 

Marvel Rivals is available on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam). The new Path to Doomsday - Avengers: Age of Ultron PvE mode will be available in Marvel Rivals on July 30, 2026 (UTC).

#IGN #SDCC
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Age of Ultron Mode Teaser Trailer | Comic Con 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest Total Chaos trailer for the survival horror game to see what to expect with the Retro Mode update. In Total Chaos, Fort Oasis is no paradise—it's a decaying nightmare where reality crumbles. The creator of Turbo Overkill unleashes survival-horror stacked with mysteries and monstrosities. Scavenge to craft weapons, while a voice on your walkie-talkie guides you into the island's depths. Total Chaos is available now on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2. The Retro Mode update is out now.
title: Total Chaos - Official Retro Mode Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Step inside the colorful world of Tukoni: Forest Keepers in this latest trailer for the upcoming puzzle adventure game. The new Tukoni: Forest Keepers trailer showcases gameplay as you get a peek into this cozy adventure. Tukoni: Forest Keepers will be available on PC (Epic Games Store, Steam, and GOG) on August 17, 2026.

Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute and cozy puzzle adventure. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness.
title: Tukoni: Forest Keepers - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: A century ago, the wealthy fled to Mars. Earth is rotting, and the underworld owns New York. In a speakeasy backroom, you verify cash paid to a crime family, using tools and guides to spot counterfeits and expose liars. With someone you love on the line, there's no room for mistakes. Watch The Money Man trailer for this upcoming narrative simulator game. The Money Man will be available on PC in 2027.
title: The Money Man - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Crack the cases, Save the City. Here's your look at the Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles announcement trailer for this upcoming 1–4 player cooperative detective adventure game. Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles will be available on Amazon Luna on July 31, 2026.

Gotham's darkest crimes won't solve themselves. Go solo or gather your crew and dive into the noir-drenched 1940s Gotham City of the Batman: Caped Crusader animated series, where every alley hides a secret, and every case leads deeper into the shadowy depths of Gotham’s criminal minds.

In this cooperative party game for 1 to 4 players, you'll join forces with Renee Montoya as part of Batman’s inner circle, uncovering evidence, chasing leads, and confronting iconic villains across 11 gripping episodes. Test your detective skills to surface clues in 11 detective minigames. Investigate, interrogate, deduce and decode your way through the crime webs woven by 10 of Gotham’s most devious criminals, including Scarecrow, Babyfac
title: Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles: Official Announcement Trailer | Comic Con 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at gameplay from Void Salvage in this trailer for the upcoming spaceship simulation game with node-based upgrades and choice-driven encounters. Combine weapon augments, modules, drones, and sockets to build a powerful ship. Unlock strategic control-panel actions for auto-combat, then prestige to pursue different paths through the story. Void Salvage will be available on PC on August 11, 2026.
title: Void Salvage - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for eBaseball Pro Spirit 2026, a free-to-play baseball simulation game developed by Konami. Players will take on the world from field to field, competing with the best teams for the thrill of victory. eBaseball Pro Spirit 2026 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: eBaseball Pro Spirit 2026 - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Spider-Man: Brand New Day Cinematic Trailer for PUBG Mobile, the hit mobile iteration of the hit battle royale game developed by Lightspeed Games and Quantum Studio. Players can get in the Spider-Man mood with the upcoming collaboration. Become a hero in the Spider-Man: Brand New Day Collaboration for PUBG Mobile, launching on July 30 for iOS and Android.
title: PUBG Mobile x Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Official Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The former general who rebelled against the Empire's cruelty joins the fight. Hailing from Final Fantasy VI, Celes wields her blade and elemental attacks to perform powerful Area of Effect attacks to stack buffs on allies and destroy enemies. Celes arrives July 28th 2026. 

Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy is available now on iOS and Android.
title: Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy - Official Character Preview: Celes Chere Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at action-packed gameplay and more from Ignoble in this latest trailer for the upcoming incremental beat-’em-up game. Destroy enemies and harvest blood, bones, and marrow to grow stronger, unlock forbidden skills, and wipe out the Ignoble tyrants who dare threaten your master. Ignoble will be available on Steam on August 12, 2026.
title: Ignoble - Official Release Date Trailer
